name: 摸鱼小游戏
description: 右侧工作面板里的休闲小游戏合集：扫雷、2048、纸牌接龙、俄罗斯方块、贪吃蛇。纯本地运行，不访问网络与文件系统；每个游戏各自记住最高分、设置与累计时长，跨会话保留。

en.name: Time-Killer Games
en.description: A local mini-game collection for the right work panel: Minesweeper, 2048, Klondike Solitaire, Tetris and Snake. Runs fully offline with no file or network access; each game keeps its own best score, settings and total play time across sessions.
en.safetyNotes: Everything runs on your own machine. The plugin makes no network requests and reads no files outside its own data directory, and it asks for a single permission: a view in the right panel. Best scores and play time are stored locally in the plugin data directory and never leave the machine.

zh-CN.name: 摸鱼小游戏

zh-CN.safetyNotes: 全部在本机运行：不发任何网络请求，也不读取自己数据目录以外的文件；只申请一个权限，即右侧工作面板里的一个视图。最高分与累计时长存在插件自己的数据目录里，不会离开本机。
